# What this page will be

A teaching page on Retrieval-Augmented Generation: why a frozen model is not enough, what embeddings are for, and the loop retrieve → augment → generate. One honest pipeline, not a product demo.

RAG is already named in the comparison table on the [Generative AI overview](generative-index.qmd). This page now lives under the [RAG and agents](/rag/rag-index.qmd) section; its URL stays here so old links do not break.
